title: 3-Hour Study With Me 🌧️ Lofi Rain Pomodoro · 3 × 50/10 Cozy Deep Focus Timer
description:
Study with me for 3 focused hours. 🌙 Three Pomodoro cycles of 50 minutes focus + 10 minutes break, with a cozy rainy-night aesthetic, a soft rain-piano soundtrack and gentle nature ambience. Put your phone away, press play and let's get things done.

⏱️ FORMAT
• 3 sessions × (50 min focus / 10 min break)
• 10-second countdown at the start
• Soft clock ticks in the last 10 seconds of every focus & break
• The scene & colors change every session so the time flies

🕖 TIMESTAMPS
00:00 — Intro & countdown
00:14 — Session 1 · Focus 50:00 (cozy rainy night)
50:14 — Session 1 · Break 10:00
1:00:14 — Session 2 · Focus 50:00 (thunderstorm night)
1:50:14 — Session 2 · Break 10:00 (rainy forest)
2:00:14 — Session 3 · Focus 50:00 (starry night)
2:50:14 — Session 3 · Break 10:00 (aurora)
3:00:14 — Well done 🎉

🎧 Best with headphones. Loop it for a full study day.

🌱 Like & subscribe for more study-with-me timers, lofi rain and deep-focus sessions.

Sound ambience: rain, birds, stream, crickets & thunder from Wikimedia Commons / public-domain sources (CC0 / CC BY / CC BY-SA).
